job: See what changed in the product lately, filter it by kind, and subscribe.
purpose: The news page of Ember's public site: a short masthead, the latest release beside the diff it makes visible, then every update as dated rows (fd-site-posts list) filtered by kind with a chip nav, and an email signup with its invalid, busy and sent states. It uses the posts list, not fd-doc-changelog: the site page mixes releases with engineering and customer posts and links to the docs release notes for detail.
useWhen: A product publishes releases, fixes and posts on its public site.
Readers want one kind of update, or to get them by email.

avoidWhen.when: The page is the versioned release notes inside the documentation.
Someone needs the live health of the service.
The page tells one story at reading length.

sections.why: Shared with the customer story: the two editorial pages of the site.
A short masthead for a page that is mostly a list; the site's one centred hero.
The latest release: its claim beside the webhook diff it makes visible.
The page itself: dated rows, one kind of update at a time.
The one action a changelog reader takes is to subscribe, in one field.
A list page ends quietly in one row.
